import concurrent.futures,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,subprocess,time,datetime
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
cache=pathlib.Path(os.environ['T166_RECEIPTS'])
file='test/isolation.test.js';sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
selected=[]
for i in range(2,6):
 log=cache/('after-test_isolation.test.js-'+str(i)+'.log');receipt=log.with_suffix('.json')
 if receipt.exists() or log.exists():continue
 with receipt.open('x') as out:json.dump({'status':'pending','run':i,'file':file},out)
 selected.append(i)
(cache/'parallel-isolation-start.json').write_text(json.dumps({'head':sha,'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'runs':selected,'file_workers':3,'cpu_load_processes':2}))
burners=[subprocess.Popen(['nice','-n','15','node','-e','for (;;) Math.sqrt(Math.random());']) for _ in range(2)]
def measure(i):
 log=cache/('after-test_isolation.test.js-'+str(i)+'.log');receipt=log.with_suffix('.json')
 start=time.monotonic();load=os.getloadavg()
 with log.open('w') as out:
  result=subprocess.run(['node',str(root/'test/run.js'),'--test-concurrency=1',file],cwd=root,env={**os.environ,'TOWER_CRANE_TEST_TMP':os.environ['TOWER_CRANE_TEST_TMP']},stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=1800)
 text=log.read_text()
 row={'file':file,'label':'after','run':i,'sha':sha,'status':result.returncode,'wall_s':time.monotonic()-start,'load_before':load,'load_after':os.getloadavg(),'cpu_load_processes':2,'runner':'parallel-isolation','tests':{k:int(re.findall('ℹ '+k+r' (\d+)',text)[-1]) for k in ['tests','pass','fail','cancelled','skipped'] if re.findall('ℹ '+k+r' (\d+)',text)},'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 receipt.write_text(json.dumps(row));print(file,i,result.returncode,flush=True)
try:
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
  for result in pool.map(measure,selected):pass
finally:
 for p in burners:p.terminate()
 for p in burners:p.wait()
